name: ENDI Corp.
summary: CrossingBridge Advisors, LLC is a publicly owned investment manager. It primarily provides its services to investment companies. The firm is a an investment adviser to an investment company which provides portfolio management for investment companies. The firm launches and manages fixed income. The firm manages equity. The firm conducts external research to make its investment. The fim was formerly known as ENDI Corp. CrossingBridge Advisors, LLC is based in Pleasantville, New York.
